description: This file defines the `Multiplication` class within the `Matrix\Operators` namespace, implementing matrix multiplication operations for matrices and scalars, including methods for executing and chaining multiplications, and handling exceptions related to invalid inputs.

classes.name: Multiplication
classes.description: A class that handles matrix and scalar multiplication operations, supporting execution, chaining, and error handling.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs multiplication with either a matrix or scalar, returning the operation object for chaining.

methods.name: multiplyScalar
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication on the matrix data within the object.

methods.name: multiplyMatrix
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication with another matrix, updating the object's internal matrix.
